blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Jeus Gabriel Derick Yape delivered the Team Philippines’ fourth gold in the Asian Games 2026 after ruling the mixed individual virtual taekwondo event on Friday at Toyohashi Gymnasium. Yape stood out in the non-contact digital combat sport where athletes wear VR headsets and motion-tracking sensors to fight opponents through avatars in a virtual arena. Yape beat Vietnam’s Chau Ngoc Tuyet Sang, 2-0, in the final, unleashing 500 hit points in the opening round. Yape, who also won bronze in the men’s individual poomsae on Thursday, joined […]...
